text:
deploy-bot: Promotion attempt failed: release 0.17.4 -> prod. Post-deploy smoke tests reporting 502s from /v1/generate on multiple inference pods. Holding rollout.

alex: seeing same, 3/6 pods returning 502s, traceback points to runtime failing to init cache. can anyone check prod configmap 'inference-config'?

priya: pulling it now.
```
$ kubectl -n inference get configmap inference-config -o yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: inference-config
data:
  LOG_LEVEL: "info"
  CACHE_TTL: "60"
# NOTE: MODEL_CACHE_SIZE missing in prod
```

lily: confirmed — prod CM does not have MODEL_CACHE_SIZE. staging has MODEL_CACHE_SIZE set to "256". operator expects env var MODEL_CACHE_SIZE (uppercase). missing it makes the runtime fall back to tiny default and causes OOM/502 under concurrency.

chris: how did that slip past e2e? staging smoke included the key. did the helm values for prod not include the new mapping?

alex: digging — infra shows prod helm release pinned to chart v1.2.0 which doesn't include the new `model.cacheSize` -> `MODEL_CACHE_SIZE` mapping added in chart v1.3.0. staging upgraded to v1.3.0 earlier. So chart pin drifted for prod. runtime image is pinned to 0.17.4 (the release we're promoting). previous image 0.17.3 had a fallback behavior. Options: 1) Hotpatch configmap in prod now (fast). 2) Roll back runtime image to 0.17.3 (safer but slower). Thoughts?

priya: hotpatch seems fastest to restore traffic. we can patch CM and trigger a rolling restart. small change, low risk. need oncall ok to touch prod CM now. @chris you good with immediate patch?

chris: ok to patch, coordinate with oncall. also need a PR to update the helm chart pin in infra so next deploy doesn't clobber it. i'll open one.

release-bot: Created PR infra/helm#1245 to update prod chart pin to v1.3.0 and add a note about MODEL_CACHE_SIZE. https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/1245

alex: applying quick patch now:
```bash
cat <<EOF | kubectl -n inference apply -f -
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: inference-config
data:
  MODEL_CACHE_SIZE: "256"
EOF
```

deploy-bot: ConfigMap inference-config updated in prod. Detected change -> initiating rolling restart for deployment inference-prod.

lily: pods are restarting. smoke tests running. so far 5/6 pods healthy after restart, one initial 502 cleared. continuing to monitor.

priya: merging infra PR now to prevent re-drift and adding release note: "hotfix: add MODEL_CACHE_SIZE to prod inference-config; align prod chart pin to v1.3.0"

chris: :thumbsup: also file a short postmortem to capture why chart pin was not updated during staging->prod promotion. we should add a check to CI that verifies critical config keys are present in prod before promoting.

alex: decision: proceed with patch (no rollback). will track follow-ups in ticket INF-789 and add a changelog entry. Promotion will remain held until postdeploy checks pass for 10 minutes.

deploy-bot: Promotion held; postdeploy checks need to pass for 10m before finalizing.
